findings.description: Story capture recorded 10 external fonts.gstatic.com NotoSansSC woff2 resources. Screenshots are rendered, but this case cannot support a zero-external-resource conclusion.

System notifications use current event cards rather than C02 summary rows. Invitation lacks the sample hero/optional attachment/separate save action. Existing payment detail does not include the full sample voucher and cross-order payment progress from design58. These screenshots verify actual current views and corrected details, not pixel-identical whole-page restoration.
503读取失败仍用“本次操作结果待核对。请恢复原请求，不能另换内容或重复发起。”的通用写入恢复文案。错误与成功空态已互斥，但文案没有准确区分GET读取与写入结果不确定。根报告R23继续记录，产品源按本次冻结约定未改。

excluded.reason: Cross-domain exploration used the story service for unrelated records; failed reads are not selected as positive evidence.
29 finance screenshots are independently reviewed by catalog; this reviewer did not repeat or claim that review.
Initial local CanvasKit connection reset failed; replaced by successful DETAIL_RECHECK_390. The same report's successful amendment remains selected.

Initial harness progress-semantics/interception assumptions and expired-fixture failures are historical only. Final four controlled-state captures come from STATE_RESULTS.json with errors=0 and business_writes=0.

limits: All records/accounts are local synthetic fixtures.
No product source was changed in this read-only review; original RESULTS files remain untouched.
No browser payments, uploads, signatures, invitations, approvals, preference saves, read acknowledgments, or load-more actions were executed by this review.
Figma photos, unavailable aggregations and closed functions remain design/model differences.
Cases may use different captured bundle hashes; no older screenshot is relabeled as the latest source.

Four controlled HTTP state cases are explicit injections/delay of GET requests, not assertions about live service outages or real account expiry. The state harness did not collect full external-resource metadata, so those fields remain null rather than claiming zero.
